heroSummary: Minneapolis Public Schools grades 1–12 start Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Pre-K and kindergarten start Thursday, September 10. Grades 10–12 should check with their school for a later start time on the first day during ninth-grade orientation. MEA Break is October 15–16, Winter Break is December 21–January 1, Spring Break is April 5–9, and the last day of school is June 11, 2027.
calendarNotes: Grades 1–12 start September 8, while Pre-K and kindergarten start September 10. Grades 10–12 should check with their school for a later start time on the first day during ninth-grade orientation. The official calendar lists 168 instructional days. October 14 is a family-teacher conference day, followed by MEA Break on October 15–16. Yom Kippur and Eid al-Fitr are no-school days for religious observances in 2026–27. Record-keeping and professional-development dates are additional non-school days for students. MPS publishes the calendar in English, Spanish, Somali, and Hmong; school bell times remain campus-specific.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Minneapolis Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 start Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Pre-K and kindergarten start Thursday, September 10. Grades 10–12 should check their high school for a possible late first-day start.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MPS MEA Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: MEA Break is October 15–16, 2026. The family-teacher conference day immediately before it, October 14, is also a non-school day.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the MPS 2026–27 school year?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Minneapolis Public Schools student calendar lists 168 instructional days. The June 28–July 22 summer-school window is separate from the regular school year.

calendarFaqs.q: Which religious observances are non-school days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists Yom Kippur on September 21, 2026, and Eid al-Fitr on March 10, 2027, as non-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find my MPS school’s start and dismissal time?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the School Start and End Times table on the official MPS calendar page. Start and dismissal times vary by campus.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 12, 2026, against the official MPS calendar hub, Back to School page, and English 2026–27 student calendar PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: The official one-page calendar lists 168 instructional days and is dated September 3, 2025.
We checked the complete calendar, including the circled first and last days and the shaded non-school dates.
The MPS Back to School page confirms the September 8 and September 10 grade-specific first days.
The MPS calendar hub provides the campus bell-time table and the School Board’s religious-observance policy.
The June 28–July 22 summer-school window is outside the 168-day regular school year.
The three translated links point to official MPS-hosted PDFs.
